RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

An all-woman panel that selected a woman over you — also a woman — tells you almost nothing about sex discrimination. Both candidates shared the same protected characteristic, so sex is very unlikely to explain the outcome. Raising the panel's composition would likely read as grievance-hunting and undermine your credibility on the points that actually matter.

The real questions are elsewhere: the gap between your fifteen years and her eight, whether "strong experience of digital media" was weighted in the advertised criteria, and whether age played any part. Your strongest move is to chase the written explanation — send a firm follow-up citing your original request date, copying HR, and ask for the scoring against published criteria.
